Transportations[]

NR[]

  • Metropolis Terminal Exit B5, D1, D2, H1, H2, H3, H4

SLT[]

  • SLT Line 101 South Bay Watergate Stop

Intersections[]

After Prapiroon Road Intersection, the road is continued by Wilde Street.

From North to South:

  • Prapiroon Road
  • Unnamed road at Red Stadium (West)
  • Bonyal Road (West) / Damrey Street (East, Pedestrian Street)
  • Metropolis Estate Road (East)
  • Red Stadium Road South (West)
  • Yi Ling Road
  • Port City Road (West)

After Port City Road Intersection, the road is continued by Southport Exhibition Centre carpark entrance.

Fun Facts[]

  • This road is named after Kisha Cat, an ex-admin and friend of the owner of Nazca Railway.
  • Several NR lines are beneath this road.
    • Arcgo Line, Pegasus Line is beneath this road between Prapiroon Road and Bonyal Road sections.
    • Origin Line is beneath this road between Prapiroon Road and Metropolis Estate Road sections.
    • Phoenix Line is beneath this road between Bonyal Road and Yi Ling Road sections.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Caven Ark.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Caven Ark 03:18
Veins of the Buried Covenant 02:34

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the permanent Down Direction Terminus of Prospektious Line.
  • For trains coming from Havenore Station, it says "Unassumed section, ride at your own risk." at this station platform 4. If you go further from here, you will only arrive at Arcgo West Island Station of the Interisland Line.
  • The Exterior Structure of this station is constructed by the developer of Peckern North.
  • The name of this station is derived from the Greek word of the same name, κιβωτός, which stands for ark, hence the Station Characteristic of this Station and the ark-like appearance of the Exterior Structure. Coincidentally, the game Blue Archive also takes place in a city of the Same Name.
  • Due to this station being a "Pioneering Station", only exits to the east are currently built.
  • This station features a large-scaled Exit Banner at the exit similar to that of Pinestand Station, Apple Hill Station, Halcedon Station and Summer Point Gateway. A similar Exit Banner would also be seen at Branches' Hallow Station.

History[]

  • January 18 2023: This Station began construction.
  • January 21 2023: This Station completed construction.[2]
  • January 23 2023: This station began services alongside Glinstrouß Line, but Prospektious Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • January 31 2023: Prospektious Line is established.
  • July 30 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[3]

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 3
  • Time Management

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station is the first station to be built in Season 2, as well as the first to be built with the upgraded Departure Routine and all Advanced Station Facilities.
  • This station is the first of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate the class teacher of the Railway Builder at SKH Chan Young Secondary School, with the other two stations being Raytree Station and Prosand Station.[2] The polished diorite and blue terracotta stripes of this station also alludes to the pattern of the suit that the class teacher wears.[3]
  • The design of Yowah North Station takes references from this station.

History[]

  • March 25 2016: This station began operations alongside Stadium Line, Echo Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • March 29 2016: Echo Line is established.
  • March 25 2017: Echo Line merged with Bravo Line, and this station became a Bravo Line Station.
  • March 24 2018: The Abyss Line part of this station completed expansion. At the same day, this station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.
  • April 28 2018: Abyss Line extends from Oganesson Station to this station.
  • April 26 2020: The section between Grass Crack and this completed elevatization works.[4]
  • November 7 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]

Fifth Anniversary Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 0
  • Just walk to the Concourse and get your souvenir.
  • The Fourth Anniversary Souvenir comes in the form of The Door of Kindness.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Chinese Name of this station is an internet term frequently used in China to describe a man that is tall （高）, rich （富） and handsome （帥）. In the context of this station, he used this term to refer to three different groupmates in an orientation camp in which the railway builder participated in.[2]
  • As the Chinese Name could be split into tall, rich, and handsome, this station has three different themes. This also meant that this station is the first station in Los Sengas Division to have multiple color schemes. The themes of the Chinese Name could be reflected from the design of this station in the form of the following:
    • Tall: The high ceiling height of the North Side of the Concourse, as well as Platforms 1 and 4.[3]
    • Rich: Red Wool, which represents Red Packets and Blocks of Gold, which represents richness. People who buy gold tend to sell them when gold prices rise to earn money.[4]
    • Handsome: Green Wool and Obsidian. According to the creator of Nazca Railway, black and green forms strong color contrasts, which could represent "Handsome".[5]
  • The Siding at Platforms 2 and 3 of this station connects directly to the Kinight Line tracks at Sheung Che Nung Station.

History[]

  • September 18 2015: This station began services.
  • August 13 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[6]
  • September 1 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Lake Lane Station is a station on Sava Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Sava. Passengers may also use this station to change to Downtown Transit Sirius Line (Lake Lane Station) and Great City Railway Lakebound Line (Lake Lane Station).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station alludes to Sha Tin Wai Station of the MTR in Hong Kong.[2]
  • The Station code of this station is LAA instead of LAL as the letter L in the last letter of a Code usually refers to a Line in Nazca Railway, such as WRL being used to represent West Ring Line.

History[]

  • July 11 2016: This Station began services.
  • October 13 2017: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[3]
  • May 23 2021: Exit C is added to this station.[4]
  • February 15 2024: The Platforms of this station are extended from 152m to 204m.
  • March 2 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[5]

Lake Winter Station is a station on Ingress Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Ingress.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is Brumal Mirror.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Where Cold Order Moves and Night Becomes String".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Brumal Mirror 02:20
Glaciel Lucentum 03:15

Fun Facts[]

  • This station, alongside Shardcone Station and Silvane Station are considered "Sister Stations" with similar design, and extra open platform spaces are seen at both ends of the platforms; Therefore, the actual length of the platforms in this station is 264m.
  • The Concourse of this Station features a flask-shaped artificial river that has its source to the east of the Station Control Annex of this station, and connects to the nearby Lake Winter, an inland freshwater lake, which is also the Namesake of this Station. Moreover, footbridges are built inside and outside the station structure to connect both sides of the artificial rover.

History[]

  • September 17 2025: This Station began construction.
  • September 19 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • September 21 2025: This Station began services.
  • October 6 2025: This station was chosen by Nazca Railway as the location of the background image during the Mid-Autumn Festival.[2]

Landing Pole Station is a station on Arcgo Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Peckern. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line, Peckern Express (Landing Pole Station) and Cities Transit Peckern City Circular (Landing Pole Station).

Station Souvenir Hints[]

 The following text contains large amounts of spoilers. Read with caution.
  • Stars: 1
  • Find the Entrance of the Landing Pole near the Los Sengas Coffee and climb to the top.
  • Once you reach the top, jump down the pool of water and then drop slowly to the station souvenir area.
  • The Station Souvenir comes in the form of a torch.

Fun Facts[]

  • The color scheme of this station pays tribute to Lighthouse Station in Terracept Division.
  • This station is built to commemorate all Core Lines passing through to the other side of West Metropolis Archipelago.

History[]

  • December 24 2015: This station began services.
  • September 23 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • July 2 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • October 30 2022: Exits D is added to this station to connect to the Cities Transit Station of the same name.[6]
  • August 23 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]
  • September 11 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[8]

Le Monde Checkpoint is a checkpoint on New Edward Line, Daring Line, Akashi Line and Bravo Line . It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Twenty-Second Continent. Passengers may also use this station to change to Nawis Railway Southern Corridor, Southern Corridor Rapid, Masquerade Line (Le Monde Station).

Station Characteristics[]

  • Prior to the New Edward Line, Akashi Line, Bravo Line extension of this station, this station was the third Floating Station to be built, and is the first Station to feature an Oceanfloor Concourse despite not being an Oceanfloor Station. However, after the expansion, as this station became an Oceanfloor Station due to the addition of eight platforms of Oceanfloor Style[4], the first example of a non-Oceanfloor Station having an Oceanfloor Concourse became invalid. Instead, this station became the first and currently the only Nazca Railway Oceanfloor Station to feature elevated platforms.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Oceanfloor Concourse of this station alluded to the first Spawnpoint in Project Nazca which was located underwater.[5]
  • The Oceanfloor extension part of this station pays tribute to Little Sea Station in Terracept Division.
  • The English Name of this Station is of French Origin, which refers to "The World", which in turn is the last card in the Major Arcana cartomanic Tarot pack.
  • Due to similarities with the words "Lemon" and "Lemonade", these two words became the nicknames of this station.
  • The Chinese name of this station had undergone changes right before the construction of this station.
  • Bravo Line temporarily adopted the right hand traffic rule at this station. As the Up Direction Platforms have doors that open to the left, and the Down Direction Platforms have doors that open to the right, this line would have to adopt the Right-Hand Traffic Rule for the convenience of trains entering the station.[6]
  • The Station Teleportation buttons of this station are placed on the floor in a fashion similar to Centopia.
  • With the increase in platform depth of the Oceanfloor Extension, the building materials also differ to increase the darkness of the color. This arrangement is similar to that of Europa Checkpoint, and the building materials used are as follows:
    • Platforms 3, 5: Block of Quartz, Chiseled Quartz Block
    • Platforms 4, 6: Block of Quartz, Stone Slab
    • Platforms 7, 9: Stone Bricks, Stone Slab
    • Platforms 8, 10: Stone Bricks, Chiseled Stone Bricks

Future Development[]

  • According to the Station Plans at the outside of this station, the confined spaces between Platforms 4, 6, Platforms 7, 9 and Platforms 8, 10 will be used as The Shuttle Platforms, The Shuttle Concourse and the Concourse of a future Hub Railway line respectively. Moreover, an additional set of Side Platforms will be built below the future Hub Railway Concourse.

History[]

  • July 18 2020: This station began services alongside Daring Line.
  • August 25 2021: The New Edward Line, Akashi Line, Bravo Line part of this station began extension. This station became a Checkpoint.
  • August 27 2021: The New Edward Line, Akashi Line, Bravo Line platforms and concourse part of this station completed expansion. At the same day, Bravo Line extends from Darey Terrace Station to this station, but New Edward Line and Akashi Line Platforms remain reserved.
  • September 7 2021: New Edward Line extends from Kallen Bay Station to this station through Quillow Terrace Station.
  • October 7 2021: Akashi Line extends from Astral City Station to this station.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Southern Corridor Concourse of this Station features two sets of side platforms perpendicular to each other, and transfer passageways in the form of stairs connect the Southern Corridor and Southern Corridor Rapid Platforms. This design is highly similar to Nazca Railway West Ring Line, Kinight Line Comic Ward Station. However, in addition to that design, a square-shaped exit passageway is also featured at the Southern Corridor Concourse of this station.
  • Due to constraints regarding tracks leaving Nagasora Station to its west, the Masquerade Line Platforms of this station are placed at approximately 170m to the east of the Southern Corridor, Southern Corridor Rapid Platforms.

title: Lean Forest Depot
safeHtml:
Lean Forest Depot was a proposed depot of the Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division that had plans to be constructed at West Metropolis Archipelago Lean Forest Island. This depot would have been the first depot in Nazca Railway to be constructed on an island, and would have acted as a base for New Edward Line, Alpha Line and Bravo Line.

Contents

  • 1 Description
  • 2 Depot Structure
    • 2.1 Connecting Tracks
  • 3 Citations and References

Description[]

It is only known that this depot would have been constructed at the northwest of Lean Forest Station.

Depot Structure[]

Connecting Tracks[]

The reserved connecting tracks to this depot was completed when Lean Forest Station is constructed, and would have emerged at the northwest of Lean Forest Island using tracks with low curvature, where it connects to the shared tracks of New Edward Line, Alpha Line and Bravo Line. However, when The Shuttle tunnels between Midway Island Node and Central Numpool Station/Node was constructed (Midway South Tunnel), the reserved tracks were connected to that tunnel instead. Given these circumstances, it is highly unlikely that Lean Forest Depot will ever be built.

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is The Resplendent Oasis.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Particles and Pinnacles".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
The Resplendent Oasis 03:08
Isle of Quiet Brilliance 02:51

Fun Facts[]

  • This station used to share structures with Southern Loop Lean Forest Station, and passengers could access the Southern Loop Platforms by taking elevators from the New Edward Line Platforms of this station. However, this means of access was cut off after this station completed Second Stage Upgrading Works, rendering the Southern Loop Lean Forest Station briefly inaccessible until an elevator was built outisde the station to once again connect the Southern Loop Platforms with ground level after the demolition of the Southern Loop Platforms at Numpool West Station.
  • The passing tracks of this station is used by Alpha Line and Bravo Line at the same time.

History[]

  • October 15 2015: This station completed construction.[2]
  • October 16 2015: This station began services.
  • September 2 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • March 6 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.
  • November 23 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[4]

History[]

  • August 1 2017: Metro Express Transport obtained operational and construction rights for Leanpool Line and began construction.
  • August 3 2017: Bonyal Peninsula Station construction complete.
  • Late August 2017: Lean Forest North Station and Lean Forest Station completed construction.
  • August 27 2017: This line extended to Numpool Station. Leanpool Line Phase I completed construction.
  • December 15 2017: Metro Express Transport obtained operational and construction rights for Leanpool Line. Leanpool Line Phase II began construction.
  • December 21 2017: Kaling Channel Station began operations.
  • December 29 2017: Aest Station completed construction and all stations have added station codes. Full line consruction complete.

Leben Island is one of the islands involved in the Centopia Nazca Railway Headquarters. Similar to Centopia Island and the other islands in Centopia, this island is also artificial.

Contents

  • 2 Transport

Location[]

Leben Island is located to the southwest of Centopia Island, the south of Orama Island and the east of Relish Island.

Transport[]

Railway[]

This island features Leben Station of the Zephyr Line.

Roads[]

This island consists of eight roads, namely Shingking Road, Yaugeoi Avenue, Hipgeoi Avenue, Sheunggeoi Road, Hageoi Road, Meigeoi Drive, Lokgeoi Drive and Yigeoi Street. Details of The Roads on this island are as follows:

Shingking Road[]

Shingking Road starts from a roundabout at the south coast of the island that is connected to Hageoi Road from both sides, and reaches the Diverging Diamond Interchange, which houses Leben Station and serves as the Public Transport Interchange (PTI) of this island. The PTI Provides access to Hipgeoi Avenue and Sheunggeoi Road with a one-lane carriageway in both directions for both roads, before proceeding north to Orama Island.

It should only be noted by the major aspect of Diverging Diamond Interchange, where it adopts Right-Hand Traffic, and the rest of this island adopts Left-Hand Traffic.

Yaugeoi Avenue[]

Yaugeoi Avenue is the Access Road from this island to Centopia Island. It only intersects with Hipgeoi Avenue at the northeast of this island near Whitemart, and crosses above Sheunggeoi Road and Hageoi Road.

Hipgeoi Avenue[]

Hipgeoi Avenue is the trunk road of this island, as well as the Access Road from this island to Relish Island. It is mostly a three-lane dual carriageway that is separated by Leben Station and Zephyr Line tracks in the center, but would be narrowed to a two-lane carriageway at both the junction with Yaugeoi Avenue at the east and the junction with Meigeoi Drive at the west. The connection to Sheunggeoi Road and Hageoi Road is further narrowed to just one lane in both directions. It should also be noted that while there is apparently only one Ring Road, it is also separated into two sections, with Sheunggeoi Road traversing along the north coast of this island and Hageoi Road traversing along the south coast of this island.

Sheunggeoi Road[]

Sheunggeoi Road traverses along the north coast of this island. It starts from the west coast of this island where Hageoi Road ends, and intersects with Meigeoi Drive, Shingking Road, Lokgeoi Drive, Hipgeoi Avenue and Yigeoi Street, before joining Hageoi Road at the east beneath Yaugeoi Avenue.

Hageoi Road[]

Hageoi Road traverses along the south coast of this island. It starts from the east coast of this island where Sheunggeoi Road ends beneath Yaugeoi Avenue, and intersects with Shingking Road at a roundaobut, before proceeding west where it intersects with Meigeoi Drive. Then, instead of following straight westwards, it briefly proceeds southwards before turning northwards once again to follow the island coastline and loop around the proposed Costco-styled Supercenter. Finally, it ends when it joins Sheunggeoi Road at the West, where it is also connected with Hipgeoi Avenue.

Meigeoi Drive[]

Meigeoi Drive is a road that runs at the west of this island and is divided into two sections. The first section is a north-south oriented two-lane dual carriageway that starts with its junction with Sheunggeoi Road and connects with Hipgeoi Avenue. This section ends at its junction with Hageoi Road, where instead of proceeding straight southwards, it would turn westwards into the second section, which is a two-lane Single Carriageway that cuts through the proposed Costco-styled Supercenter, before ending where Sheunggeoi Road proceeds North.

Lokgeoi Drive[]

Lokgeoi Drive is a one-lane Dead End Street that branches off from Sheunggeoi Road featuring a Roundabout at its south end.

Yigeoi Street[]

Yigeoi Street is a one-lane street at the east end of this island that would feature the East Outdoor Grocery Mall at its north side and the Walmart-styled Supermall, which is named Whitemart, at its south side. It connects with Hipgeoi Avenue to the west and Sheunggeoi Road to the east.

Facilities[]

Immediately after reclamation works completed on this island, it was already announced that this island would feature a Public Transport Interchange (PTI) at the center, with two high-density residential areas, two low-density residential areas, two parks, two outdoor Grocery Malls and two Supercenters, one on each side of the island. Moreover, the west side of this island will also feature a Secondary School and one of the Supercenters which will be Costco-styled, and the east side of this island featuring a Primary School, a Community Center and the other supercenter which will be Walmart-styled.

The following are the facilities on Leben Island in chronological order of completion besides of Leben Station and its corresponding Public Transport Interchange (PTI).

Whitemart[]

More info on this chatper could be seen at Whitemart.

Whitemart is located at the south side of Yigeoi Street and the north side of Yaugeoi Avenue. It is built as the Walmart-styled Supermall for this island, and had completed construction on January 30 2024.

East Outdoor Grocery Mall[]

The Outdoor Grocery Mall to the East of this island is located at the north side of Yaugeoi Avenue directly opposite to Whitemart. It is built in the style of a Typical Retail Park. It provides a total of 186 parking spaces for three separate buildings which houses five different chain stores.

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this island Leben is taken from the German language, and corresponds to the Chinese Name of this island, which could be directly translated to "Cozy Residence".[2]
  • Development on this island have been sub-contracted to other developers in Los Sengas.
  • The English Names of all roads on this island are Homophonic Romanizations from their Chinese Names in the form of Jyutping.
  • The first word of the Chinese Names of Sheunggeoi Road and Hageoi Road alludes to "Up" and "Down", which corresponds to the fact that the roads traverse the north and south coasts of this island respectively.

Development Progress[]

Currently, the PTI, Leben Station, Whitemart and the East Outdoor Grocery Mall have completed construction.

History[]

  • December 4 2023: This island completed reclamation works.
  • December 18 2023: Leben Station began services. At the same day, the road link to Orama Island completed construction.
  • December 29 2023: The road link to Centopia Island completed construction. At the same day, this island completed road pavement.
  • January 28 2024: All roads on this island have been named. At the same day, the East Outdoor Grocery Mall and Whitemart began construction.
  • January 30 2024: Whitemart completed construction.
  • January 31 2024: The East Outdoor Grocery Mall completed construction.
